newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia March crude palm oil output up 35.71 pct.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia March crude palm oil output up 35.71 pct.

text.p: Malaysia's crude palm oil output rose 35.71 percent to 683,196 tonnes in March from 503,415 in February and against 643,586 in March 1996, the Palm Oil Registration and Licensing Authority (PORLA) said on Tuesday.
March palm oil exports were 565,219 tonnes against 380,267 in February and 567,911 in March 1996, it said.
PORLA said Peninsular Malaysia's crude palm oil output rose 35.36 percent to 511,927 tonnes in March from 378,197 in February and 489,699 in March 1996.
Output from east Malaysian states of Sabah and Sarawak rose 36.78 percent to 171,269 tonnes in March from 125,218 in February and against 153,887 in March last year.
Malaysia's palm kernel oil production rose 55.19 percent to 91,446 tonnes in March from 58,925 in February and against 90,710 in March 1996.
